subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Habari RECIPIENT_NAME,
Kwa kufuatia barua yangu ya awali kuhusu ubadilishaji wa walipaji kwa {Brand}, kuna jambo jipya: data za benchmark za 2026 zinaonyesha CPI ya michezo duniani imepanda 30% mwaka hadi mwaka, ikifika wastani wa $0.56, huku midcore na mkakati ikikaa kati ya $3.25 na $5.50 kwa usakinishaji. Hapo ndipo zabuni inayotegemea thamani na uchujaji wa nyongeza huamua gharama yako halisi kwa kila mlipaji aliyethibitishwa, kama studio kama Supercell na Scopely zinavyolenga. Je, ungependa tulinganishe na mchanganyiko wako wa sasa wa vyanzo?
angle: fresh angle: timely 2026 CPI +30% YoY development + midcore/strategy CPI band $3.25-$5.50
register_notes: Stage 2 sw Kenya gaming midcore/hardcore: acknowledges 2nd follow-up and references prior email in first sentence; fresh angle = timely sourced development (2026 mobile-game UA cost benchmarks: global gaming CPI +30% YoY to $0.56) plus midcore/strategy CPI band $3.25-$5.50, both sourced at the foxdata benchmark URL in enrichment_sources; no MobUpps figure this stage; peers Supercell and Scopely reused from parent only (no new brands); acronyms CPI kept Latin; one question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'; no hedge before figures (ranges allowed).
